entries.address: W Sunset Blvd at Temescal Canyon Rd, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
entries.notes: Ground-level inspection showed some exterior smoke damage and broken windows. Structure appears largely intact. Team was unable to access upper floors due to road conditions. Assessment may be incomplete given access constraints.

entries.address: 1482 Sunset Mesa Drive, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
entries.notes: Complete structural loss. Roof collapsed, all four walls down. Active embers present. Utility meter destroyed. Do not enter.
Exterior siding scorched on south and west faces. Deck partially burned. Windows intact. Roof appears undamaged from street. Interior not accessed.
Garage fully burned through. Fire spread to attached dwelling — front half of structure gutted. Rear rooms may be salvageable. Gas shutoff confirmed.
Fence line burned. Small shed in backyard destroyed. Main dwelling shows no visible fire damage. Landscaping lost on north side.
Full burn. Concrete foundation and chimney stack only remaining. Vehicle in driveway also destroyed. Neighboring trees still smoldering.
No visible damage. Structure appears intact. Occupants had pre-wetted roofline — possible factor. Area cleared, no active fire threat at time of assessment.
East-facing exterior wall has moderate char. Eave venting shows soot intrusion. Windows cracked but not blown. Team recommends full interior inspection before re-entry.

source: Los Angeles County Building and Safety Inspection Team

entries.address: 1482 Sunset Mesa Drive, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
entries.notes: Total loss confirmed. Foundation cracked from heat stress. Red-tagged. Asbestos hazard possible — built circa 1962. Hazmat referral submitted.

Inspector accessed interior via owner consent. Attic fully compromised by fire intrusion through vents. Load-bearing wall on west side shows structural failure. Red-tagged. NOT safe for occupancy. Severity upgraded from initial drive-by estimate.
Single-story ranch home. Rear portion of structure shows roof sag and exterior burn marks. Windows failed on south side. Yellow-tagged pending structural engineer review.
Confirmed severe damage. Attached garage and front living area destroyed. Rear bedroom wing structurally questionable. Red-tagged. Owner notified by door notice.
Total loss. Only chimney and partial foundation wall standing. Debris field extends onto sidewalk — public hazard flagged. Demolition order initiated.

entries.address: 519 Pampas Ricas Boulevard, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
entries.notes: Exterior stucco discolored from heat and smoke. No structural compromise identified. Green-tagged. Recommend smoke remediation inside before occupancy.
Char damage on east wall confirmed. Roof decking intact. No interior access granted by occupant. Yellow-tagged. Follow-up inspection required within 72 hours.
Two-story residence fully burned. Second floor pancaked onto first. Propane tank in rear yard appears to have BLEVE'd — scorch radius 40 ft. Red-tagged, perimeter tape placed.

entries.address: Malibu Colony beachfront, Pacific Coast Highway, Malibu CA 90265 destroyed structures debris
entries.notes: Total loss of multiple beachfront residences along Malibu Colony PCH corridor. Foundation slabs and chimney stacks remaining. Hazmat referral submitted. Red-tagged.

entries.address: Big Rock Las Tunas Beach along PCH near Pacific Palisades Malibu boundary coastal structures
entries.notes: Significant fire damage along Las Tunas / Big Rock Beach corridor. Roof and second-story burned through on multiple structures. Ground floor partially intact. Yellow-tagged pending structural engineer review.

source: American Red Cross Disaster Assessment Team — Los Angeles Chapter

entries.notes: Residents sheltering in place. Backyard shed destroyed, fence lost. Home habitable. Family of 4 declined shelter referral. Provided emergency kit and contact card.
Occupants present and safe. No damage to dwelling. Residents assisting neighbors. Offered mental health resources and supply drop-off.
Elderly resident (82F) found on scene. Rear bedroom area has burned-out roof section. Resident displaced. Transported to Palisades Recreation Center shelter. Pets (2 dogs) accommodated.

entries.address: 519 Pampas Ricas Boulevard, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
entries.notes: Couple evacuated voluntarily. Returned to assess. Exterior smoke damage only. Home considered habitable. Registered family in disaster relief database.
No occupants located on scene. Neighbors report family of 3 evacuated night prior. Structure fully destroyed. Address flagged for welfare check follow-up. Personal property unrecoverable.
Resident present, mildly distressed. East wall charred. Resident chose to remain — signed acknowledgment waiver. Provided N95 masks and air quality advisory.

Resident reported structure as severely damaged with roof failure and broken gas line. Team located address marker but building could not be confirmed at this parcel — possible address discrepancy or demolition predating fire. Flagged for GIS verification. No occupants found.
